annotations.title: Translate the text in an image

description: Replace the text inside a product image with a translation, keeping fonts, colours and layout. Give the image as a URL. Returns the translated image.

font.description: A font name from supported fonts. Default Pretendard.

image_url.description: An http(s) URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

source_language.description: The language of the text in the image, or auto.

target_language.description: The language to translate into, e.g. ko, en, ja, zh-CN.

name: translate_image
title: Translate the text in an image
